description: Wraps GET /api/experiences. List published experiences with filters and sorting, to choose a journey. With an API key and mine=true, lists your own experiences instead, drafts included.

duration.description: short: up to 2 hours; medium: several hours to multi-day; long: weeks.

mine.description: With an API key: list your own experiences, drafts included.

since.description: ISO 8601 time: only experiences changed after it, for polling.

name: browse_experiences
title: Browse experiences
